versions.changelog: Adds five state-based vineyard controls before reception: soil-water, rhizosphere diagnosis, fruit microclimate, skin microbiology and harvest segmentation; includes optional material fingerprint evidence.
Nine-gate Vin-Q Method; live constructor and A2A discovery; deterministic decision-system metadata; current privacy, adult-use and alcohol-delivery controls.
Initial release: brand-to-wine concepts, constructor dossier, evidence gates, adult consent, and producer review workflow.
